title: Front End Developer
description:
**Role: Frontend Developer**

**Experience: 2–4years**

**Primary Focus: Responsive UI and performance.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**\* Develop and maintain DroneTV web application using Angular / React.**

**\* Build responsive and modern UI categories, creators and content discovery.**

**\* Integrate frontend with REST APIs for users, authentication, categories and other platform data.**

**\* Build reusable components and maintain a scalable frontend architecture.**

**\* Implement authentication and authorization using JWT/OAuth or similar mechanisms.**

**\* Optimize page loading, video loading, Core Web Vitals, caching and overall application performance.**

**\* Ensure the platform works properly across desktop, tablet and mobile.**

**\* Handle API errors, loading states, empty states and edge cases properly.**

**\* Work closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers and product team.**

**\* Integrate analytics and tracking where required.**

**\* Write clean, maintainable and reusable code and participate in code reviews.**

**\* Debug production issues and continuously improve the DroneTV platform.**

**\* Maintain Git\-based development workflow and contribute to CI/CD deployments.**

**Must\-Have Skills**

**Frontend**

**\* Angular / React**

**\* TypeScript / JavaScript**

**\* HTML5, CSS3**

**\* Responsive design**

**\* REST API integration**

**\* RxJS / state management**

**\* Git**

**\* Understanding of CDN, caching**

**Performance**

**\* Web performance optimization**

**\* Lazy loading**

**\* Code splitting**

**\* Image/video optimization**

**\* Core Web Vitals**

**\* Browser debugging**

**What we expect from this person**

**The developer should be capable of taking a UI → frontend implementation → API integration → testing → performance optimization → production deployment.**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
